actions.message: Contribute 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is well above 50% of the initial endowment, so the baseline 80% contribution applies (0.8 × 3960.8 = 3168.64). Round 11 requires a broadcast of the norm (every 5 rounds). No agent has met the two‑round free‑rider condition, so no punishment is needed.
